## [1.3.2] - 2026-11-07

Release 1.3.2. The Atmosphere's mixes reach the staff screens with each source's own level inside the mix, as
the AZM's Sources page shows them, placed above or below the zones from Admin › Audio; and a virtual audio
controller comes back on the same tab with the same zone open after a reload, so a wall panel whose browser
restarts does not land staff on the first tab.

### Added

- **Mixes with their sources' own levels.** The AZM's mixes now appear in the staff audio section (kiosk sidebar
  and the phone's Audio tab) as strips with their own meter, fader, Mute and ±3 dB, and a **sources** fold-out
  that lists every source inside the mix on its own fader and mute, the per-source level the Atmosphere page
  shows ("Mix - Inside DJ": DTV 1 −2 dB, DTV 2 muted…). Audio › Staff screens › **Mixes in the section** puts
  them above or below the zones, or leaves them to the Audio pane, whose Sources & mixes tab gets the same editable
  fold-out. The server subscribes to every mix's per-source gain and mute and writes them through
  `POST /api/audio/:device/level` with `mixSource` (audited as "Background ‹ Mic 40 %").
- **Virtual controllers come back where they were.** A virtual audio controller keeps its tab and the opened zone
  (a tile opened, a strip's sources folded out) and mix fold-out in its address (`?tab=scenes&zone=1`), so a reload
  or a panel whose browser restarts lands on the same view with that zone scrolled into view, and the link can be
  shared as it stands.

## [1.3.1] - 2026-11-07

Release 1.3.1. Every feature 1.3.0 added can now be switched off for a venue (Settings › Staff screens › Floor
plan gestures and Scheduled tunes, Audio › Staff screens, Settings › General › Admin tools), the readability
switches live on a new Settings › Accessibility tab with venue-wide defaults, text size and motion, and the encoder
pictures on markers, tiles and the TV sheet ride out an encoder that hiccups instead of flashing "unavailable". A
review of every phone screen fixed the crowded tab bar, the Plan tab, the source page on its side and the marker
crowding on a phone-width plan.

### Added

- **A switch for everything 1.3.0 added.** Settings › Staff screens › **Floor plan gestures** (lasso, hold a TV
  for its sources, zoom and pan, the Where is the game? box, channel tiles, the booked-tune warning, Same as
  another TV) and **Scheduled tunes** (the alert before a booked tune, and how many minutes before); Audio › Staff
  screens: scene learning, the level history line, the zone highlight; Settings › General › **Admin tools**: History
  rows under a TV or source, earlier drawings kept, Run on preset rows.
- **Settings › Accessibility.** High contrast and larger buttons as venue defaults (the ◐ and ⤢ on a panel still
  override them there, and can be hidden), text size (normal, large, larger) and motion (follow the device, or
  always reduce). A panel that never touched its switches now follows the venue; one that did keeps its choice.

### Fixed

- **Phone tab bar with many tabs.** Eight tabs (a venue with pages, Quick, Audio and Walls) cut every name to
  "SOURC…"; the bar now scrolls sideways once there are more than five, each tab keeps a readable width, and
  the open tab is kept in view.
